Depending on whether you mean **buying HubSpot software/subscriptions** for your business or **buying HubSpot stock (NYSE: HUBS)** as an investment, here is what you need to know:

### Option 1: Buying HubSpot Software (CRM & Hubs)

HubSpot offers a modular, cloud-based CRM platform with free tiers and paid software packages depending on what your business needs (Marketing, Sales, Service, Content, and Operations).[[1]](https://www.hubspot.com/pricing/marketing)[[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/HUBS/)

- **Free CRM Tier:** [$0/month](https://www.hubspot.com/pricing/marketing) (includes basic tools and up to 2 users).
- **Starter Plans:** Starts around $7–$20/seat/month depending on monthly vs. annual commitment.
- **Professional Plans:** Starts around $800–$890/month (includes core seats, expanded contacts, and a required onboarding fee).
- **Enterprise Plans:** Starts around $3,600+/month for large-scale operations.[[1]](https://www.hubspot.com/pricing/marketing)
👉 **How to buy/get started:** You can sign up or explore tiers directly on the HubSpot Marketing Software Pricing Page or talk to their sales team.[[1]](https://www.hubspot.com/pricing/marketing)

### Option 2: Buying HubSpot Stock (NYSE: HUBS)

If you are looking to purchase shares in HubSpot, Inc. as a publicly traded company:

- **Ticker Symbol:** `HUBS` (Listed on the NYSE).[[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/HUBS/)
- **Current Trading Context:** Recently trading around the **$217 USD** range (with general market volatility across SaaS and cloud-software sectors).[[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/HUBS/)
- **How to buy:** You will need a brokerage account (such as Fidelity, Charles Schwab, Robinhood, E*TRADE, etc.). Search for ticker **HUBS** , choose your order type (market or limit), and execute the trade through your broker.
